answer: Under progeny-proof-weight minting, every join request in the nebula network must include a proof-of-work whose difficulty equals base_hash multiplied by the square of total descendants already spawned across the sponsor's entire lineage. A first identity through an unsullied sponsor solves a trivial puzzle in under a second on the terrace node's laptop, so honest agents pay almost nothing. Attack cost grows nonlinearly while a lone newcomer on the reef keeps solving only the trivial base puzzle, staying orders of magnitude cheaper than any mass attacker.
